evidence: Modifies the core monetary type definition in src/consensus/amount.h and associated consensus primitives.
rationale: Making CAmount a distinct class enforces compile-time type safety on consensus monetary arithmetic. As noted in the description, wrapping the raw integer typedef 'prevents nonsensical operations such as multiplying two currency amounts' and eliminates implicit conversions from bools and floats that previously caused bugs. While an improvement to safety, it is an internal refactoring without an active bug fix or consensus rule change, making review worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
